purpose: One isolated Windows x64 CPU runtime for the synthetic-only Milestone 2 neural lifecycle preflight. This inventory does not authorize or perform download, installation, adoption, model execution, benchmark access, training, inference, or evaluation.

python.sha256_source: The SHA-256 is the message digest in the official Sigstore bundle; the artifact itself was not downloaded.
python.license: Python Software Foundation License Version 2 and incorporated notices
python.prospective_install_mode: Per-user, non-admin, quiet installation into the exact Active-only runtime root with launcher, PATH mutation, associations, shortcuts, documentation, tests, and bundled pip disabled.

resolver.name: uv
resolver.role: Already-installed resolution and installation tooling only; the executable is not copied into project custody and is not the candidate Python runtime.
resolver.network_metadata_action: uv lock resolved registry metadata only with UV_CACHE_DIR under C:\Projects\Active; no package was installed or downloaded into a runtime.

lineage_observation.reuse_prohibited: The source virtual environment and its interpreter are not copied, modified, executed as the Experiment Three runtime, or adopted. Only version and metadata lineage informed this minimized candidate.

package_resolution.lock_entry_note: The extra lock entry is the non-Windows torch 2.13.0 variant; Windows resolves exactly torch 2.13.0+cpu.

yes_would_authorize: Download the exact official CPython installer, Sigstore bundle, and exact locked wheels into Active-only private custody
Verify every available size, SHA-256, and official signature binding before use
Construct the isolated runtime at the exact Active-only root without system PATH, file-association, launcher, or admin changes
Install only the exact Windows closure bound by lock SHA-256 66ef4a354db2a1e51bd6ebeca81844c1f71497c1f8164e27b99816da5ce2e081
Capture licenses and execute import, CPU-only, deterministic-algorithm, and synthetic compatibility preflights
yes_would_not_authorize: Benchmark access or substantive training, checkpointing, inference, evaluation, tuning, or publication
Any version substitution, dependency addition, credential, terms acceptance, spend, paid service, secret, OneDrive custody, or prior-repository mutation
Any model-family, frozen-protocol, cohort, label, split, metric, threshold, or claim change
approval_scope.no_effect: Rejects this exact candidate. Milestone 2 remains blocked unless the owner separately approves a different exact runtime candidate.

known_risks: A new executable and binary wheels will execute third-party native code if adopted.
Rasterio wheels bundle GDAL and supporting data whose exact runtime behavior must be checked on the target Windows host.
CPU deterministic settings reduce but do not automatically prove replay; exact synthetic replay remains a separate gate.
The installed Experiment One lineage is evidence of compatibility, not evidence that the fresh isolated runtime will pass.
mitigations: Active-only private download, cache, runtime, and output roots
No benchmark access during runtime activation
Fail closed on any hash, signature, import, CPU, dependency, or custody mismatch
